stories.title: Indian markets open higher in Muhurat session, Sensex up 320 points, Nifty above 25,100
stories.summary: On Sunday, November 8, the Indian stock market opened a special Muhurat trading session for Samvat 2083, with the Sensex gaining 320 points at the opening bell and the Nifty moving above the 25,100 level. Tata Steel and Sun Pharma were among the top gainers. The Nifty had closed the previous Friday at 25,030.35, already above key support levels.
stories.why: The rise signals bullish sentiment at the start of the Samvat year, a factor investors monitor.

stories.title: Indian economy to grow faster, foreign capital returning to markets: NSE CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan
stories.summary: Domestic financial savings have significantly increased, reaching nearly USD 1.4 trillion annually. Furthermore, foreign institutional investors are showing renewed enthusiasm for Indian markets ahead of the new Samvat year.
